hypotheses.claim: The admitted current G9 grammar is not surface-closed over admitted current G9 semantic/dialect artifacts.
hypotheses.mechanism: Grammar omits relational comparisons, structured if statements and typed interface method signatures that current artifacts use.
hypotheses.expected: Targeted current-artifact constructs fail a grammar-coverage audit while grammar-native positive controls pass.
hypotheses.observed: 5/5 targeted constructs failed; 0/2 positive controls failed.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: These constructs are presentation-only notation outside the intended parser surface.
hypotheses.falsifier: A real current parser generated from the admitted grammar parses the complete current G9 V3 spec and dialect registry with deterministic ASTs without hidden grammar extensions.
hypotheses.next_test: Run the actual parser over the complete CURRENT stack corpus and compare accepted grammar hash to declared grammar.ebnf.

hypotheses.claim: The observed closure failures can be repaired as parser/grammar surface work without changing ClayCode semantic primitives.
hypotheses.mechanism: Add comparison productions, typed method signatures and if statement syntax while retaining existing semantic IR records/rules/capability model.
hypotheses.expected: The same targeted corpus closes without adding new semantic classes.
hypotheses.observed: Targeted audit failure count fell from 5 to 0 under the minimal candidate grammar additions.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The missing syntax reflects deeper missing execution semantics and will fail once a real parser/typechecker/lowerer is built.
hypotheses.falsifier: Full parser/type/effect/compiler implementation requires a new semantic primitive to preserve intended behavior of these constructs.
hypotheses.next_test: Implement parser + AST nodes + type/effect rules and compile representative rule/control/interface fixtures.

hypotheses.claim: Expression precedence/associativity is currently underspecified enough to threaten deterministic canonical IR.
hypotheses.mechanism: grammar.ebnf uses a flat expr = primary { operator primary } form across arithmetic, comparison, implication, boolean and requires operators without a visible precedence table.
hypotheses.expected: Mixed-operator expressions admit multiple plausible semantic groupings or parser-specific grouping conventions.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The canonical IR intentionally stores a flat ordered operator chain and the type/effect layer deterministically interprets it, making precedence unnecessary at syntax level.
hypotheses.falsifier: A versioned canonicalization rule or parser test corpus proves one deterministic semantic grouping for all mixed operators with stable semantic hashes.
hypotheses.next_test: Generate mixed-operator mutation corpus and differential-parse/canonicalize across two independent parser implementations.

hypotheses.claim: A WebAssembly Component/WASI adapter is a strong first Ubuntu backend candidate for typed ClayCode FFI/effect boundaries without granting ambient authority.
hypotheses.mechanism: WIT provides typed interface imports/exports and WASI exposes host interaction through capabilities/resources; ClayCode can lower its typed EffectIntent/Capability boundary into host interfaces while keeping model output non-authoritative.
hypotheses.expected: APP-02/03/08 exemplars can compile through a typed component/WASI adapter and ungranted resources fail deterministically.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Native Ubuntu ABI/FFI is simpler/faster and WASM/WASI adds unacceptable impedance or performance cost for FRANK workloads.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched app proofs show WASI cannot express required host effects or imposes unacceptable latency/memory/interop overhead compared with native lowering.
hypotheses.next_test: Compile a minimal ClayCode file/HTTP capability exemplar to WIT/WASI and native adapter with matched receipts.

hypotheses.claim: Current generic record/tensor/rule constructs can represent loop-of-loops, GWT, Hyperposition and Emergenz readout semantics without branch-specific language primitives.
hypotheses.mechanism: Required branch semantics are primarily typed state/readout/intervention structures and relations, which map to records, sets, ordered values, tensors and rules already present in G9.
hypotheses.expected: Representative branch fixtures parse, typecheck and lower without semantic escape hatches after grammar closure.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: At least one branch requires first-class temporal/intervention/hyperrelation semantics not faithfully expressible in the current IR.
hypotheses.falsifier: A concrete executable branch fixture cannot preserve required identity, role, temporal, provenance, uncertainty or authority semantics under current IR.
hypotheses.next_test: Build one compact fixture each for GWT WorkspaceEpisode, HyperpositionReadout, LoopDynamicsReadout, EmergenceReadout, ClayGraph hyperrelation and UnifiedDB transaction receipt.

hypotheses.claim: ClayCode interconnect protocol text has branch-count/name drift relative to the authoritative current registry.
hypotheses.mechanism: CLAYCODE_RESEARCH_PROTOCOL says eight branches and uses clay in priority; current registry renamed integrated trigger to clayresearch and includes harness as required foundation.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The old name is only a harmless room alias and preflight is registry-driven.
hypotheses.falsifier: Current preflight and every consuming tool normalize alias/count correctly with no omitted foundation.
hypotheses.next_test: Run tools/research_interconnect_preflight.py on repo-local execution and assert exact registry-derived branch set.
